verdict.rationale: Visa's docs describe a concrete scoped-credential model: agent-specific payment tokens (not raw PANs), spend caps via purchase-intent mandates (declineThreshold, effectiveUntilTime), merchant-restricted credential retrieval (merchantInformation.merchantName tied to the request), and passkey-anchored user authorization before any credential is issued — exactly matching the amount/expiry/merchant-scoping story. Some caveats exist: the capability page notes the product 'is in the process of development and deployment,' and community commentary suggests true agent-specific cards with embedded policies are still a few years off, indicating maturity limits rather than a functional contradiction. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of these scoping mechanics in production, and confirmation the feature is fully live rather than still rolling out.
